unprotect_branch.description: Remove protection from a previously protected branch. Use this to remove protection from an existing branch; use `protect_branch` to change access levels without removing the rule. The operation changes repository security controls, requires permission to manage protected branches, and returns the result or an error when the branch is missing or policy forbids the change.

branch_name.description: Name of the protected branch to unprotect

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
